title: The Croak Behind the Grass
synopsis: A rounded bup leads the friends to Rill, a young frog in yellow boots, and a new friendship begins at Reed Meadow.
continuity_state: Before: Reed Meadow mapped; two blue-notebook pages finished; no frog friend introduced. After: Rill and Aunt Cress are established at Reed Meadow; Rill wears yellow boots, one with a blue patch; Tess marks a tiny yellow boot on map; third sound-book page holds bup; Rill has not visited village.
